what_went_wrong: SSH poll windows >60s (90s/300s/480s) return empty output then hit local tool timeout; 15s and 60s polls succeed reliably against <ip>.
root_cause: Long-lived interactive SSH sessions to the VPS drop or stall without ServerAlive forcing; remote poll_terminal.sh may complete but stdout never returns to PowerShell wrapper.
what_i_did_wrong: Chose multi-minute blocking SSH polls after earlier empty returns; should have capped at 60s immediately once the pattern appeared.
corrective_action: Use poll_terminal.sh with arg <=60 only; rely on VPS-side watch_terminal.sh + budget_guard for terminal detection; sparse short probes for status.
impact: Lost wall time on timed-out polls; no data loss; judge/guard unaffected on VPS.
